messages:
evelyn: Quick sync: we need a short, unambiguous lease contract for hosted/dedicated/private. Key points: TTL defaults, how evictions are signaled, and cache handling.
hao: My proposal: claim TTLs: hosted=90s, dedicated=30s, private=300s. Runtimes renew at 1/3 TTL with jitter. If renew missed -> lease state DRAIN then FORCE after grace window.
mike: For signaling, use both HTTP headers and a final stream control event. Headers: X-RW-Lease-State: ACCEPT|DRAIN|FORCE and X-RW-Lease-Reason: PREEMPT|AUTHZ|RESTART. Stream event example: {"event":"lease_update","state":"DRAIN","reason":"PREEMPT"}.
evelyn: Good. Cache policy: include cache_action in the event: invalidate|preserve|async_invalidate. For AUTHZ or COMPROMISE -> must invalidate synchronously. PREEMPT -> async recommended.
hao: Tokens: claim token must include mode, resource_pin (model@sha), and allowed_fallbacks. No wildcard models. For private allow claim_delegated=true and issuer field pointing to customer control plane.
mike: Ops: runtime behind NAT must write local lease journal and POST on reconnect. Also emit metrics: lease_renew_success, lease_evictions_total{reason,mode}.
infra-bot: deploybot: leasing-protocol v1 scheduled to canary on 2026-04-01 03:00Z.
evelyn: Decision: I'll draft RFC with wire examples, default numbers above, and rollout notes. Reviewers: @hao @mike. Please flag urgent objections now.
